verdict.rationale: Repository rulesets can require pull requests, reviews, passing checks and CODEOWNERS approval on matching branches, with an Evaluate mode for trialling rules before enforcing them. Checks come from Buildkite builds and synced GitHub Actions results. missing for 10: a documented checks/status API for posting arbitrary custom quality or compliance checks beyond Buildkite and GitHub Actions, detail on configuring which specific checks are required, independent or hands-on corroboration.
